Input

A native input element that automatically works with Field.

Interactive demo requires JavaScript.

Source files

CSS Modules

docs/demos/input/hero/css-modules/index.tsx

docs/demos/input/hero/css-modules/index.module.css

Tailwind

docs/demos/input/hero/tailwind/index.tsx

Usage guidelines

  • Form controls must have an accessible name: It can be created using a <label> element or the Field component. See the forms guide.

Anatomy

Import the component and use it as a single part:

API reference

A native input element that automatically works with Field. Renders an `<input>` element.
